scope: Exact-KC offline compiler-mangling callsite audit only. No runtime calls, loadable pool/queue class layouts, link/load success, BSD attachment, or native Wi-Fi functionality are established.

helpers.name: workQueue
helpers.return_contract: Owned IO80211WorkQueue pointer on success; null after failed init and release. First-created default pointer has separate unproved teardown lifetime.

helpers.name: poolWithName
helpers.return_contract: Owned IOSkywalkPacketBufferPool pointer on success; null after failed Boolean initializer and release.
helpers.input_contract: PoolOptions is 32 bytes: six unsigned words at offsets 0..20, optional DMA specification pointer at +0x18; the pointed-to DMA layout is intentionally opaque. Packet type 0..2, non-null options; downstream validation may still fail.

helpers.name: txSimpleWithPool
helpers.return_contract: Owned IOSkywalkTxSubmissionQueue pointer or null, forwarded from the full factory.
helpers.input_contract: Seven-argument simple factory. TX callback returns unsigned and receives IOSkywalkPacket * const * (PKP), not const IOSkywalkPacket **. This simple form supplies null query callback and UINT_MAX service class to the full factory; it does not use the obsolete full-overload signature.

helpers.name: rxSimpleWithPool
helpers.return_contract: Owned IOSkywalkRxCompletionQueue pointer on success; null after failed Boolean initializer and release.
helpers.input_contract: Seven-argument factory. RX callback returns unsigned and receives IOSkywalkPacket **. No callback body or ownership behavior is implemented by this probe.

helpers.name: txCompletionWithPool
helpers.return_contract: Owned IOSkywalkTxCompletionQueue pointer on successful init; failure releases the new object and returns null. This does not establish callback quiescence or safe release of a live queue.
helpers.input_contract: Seven-argument factory. Initializer rejects null pool, capacity less than 2, or nonzero options. Completion callback returns unsigned and takes IOSkywalkPacket **, distinct from submission's packet * const * callback. Successful creation alone does not enable a queue or register it.

helpers.name: initRegistrationInfo
helpers.return_contract: Boolean: non-null info, version exactly 1 and size exactly 0x130 are required. The probe borrows the pointer and forwards version/size without constructing a description.

helpers.name: registerEthernetInterface
helpers.return_contract: Full 32-bit IOReturn, zero success; never interpret as bool. This array overload takes const RegistrationInfo * and a final unsigned options argument.

helpers.name: registerInfraEthernetInterface
helpers.return_contract: Full 32-bit IOReturn, zero success. Input RegistrationInfo * is mutable, unlike the Ethernet helper; no final options argument.

helpers.name: deregisterEthernetInterface
helpers.return_contract: Full 32-bit IOReturn; propagates network deregistration status. Frees the Ethernet registration description only when that status is zero. This is not proof of hardware/callback drain.
